text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the showdown between Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap heats up—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, did you happen to forget someone~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: W-W-Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'em, Creek!
Right there, show 'em what ya got!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Super Creek! It's Super Creek!
Super Creek takes first place in the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The final GⅠ of the Classic Road! Squeezing in at the last minute
because another Umamusume withdrew!
And against all odds, an overwhelming victory!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~. It took right down to the wire
compared to Oguri-chan, but next up is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to the Arima Kinen~
Please count me in too,
Tama-chan, Ogri-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Creek, you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —On the way back.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri, how've things been lately?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Lately... let's see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm very hungry. Very.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: *slumps* Geez, you're always like that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The bigger the race gets, the more energy I need.
That's why I get such a huge appetite.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Racing against Creek on top of Tama just makes me...
even more nostalgic for Toki-san's nikujaga
and Ine-san's dote-kushi skewers...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's grab something to eat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, hey!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a daze, Oguri Cap was drawn
straight into Kyoto's famous food alley.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few nights later—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Damn it... Damn it, not again...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still... yeah, I guess.
Guess it had to end up like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross stood frozen before her leftover food, gritting her teeth.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...I can't eat it again. Lately, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross confessed.
It seems her small appetite has started acting up again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was a sign—a slight one.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The bento before the race today was crazy
good. Wonder if that helped too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's what Tamamo Cross said after the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Looking at it from the other side—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are times when 'it usually doesn't taste good.'
Which means that state is starting to set in...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She's the opposite of that... Oguri can still eat.
She is eating. More than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This is the difference between us... She eats more the more she's backed into a corner, but on the flip side, I lose my appetite...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: If this keeps up, I'll...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It is true that losing one's appetite carries a heavy toll. However—"
choice_data_list: That's also proof that you're "getting into peak shape".
That's also proof that you're "getting into peak shape".

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"She's in peak shape? Ain't she just
headed for disaster?"
choice_data_list: Your body is starting to prepare for the decisive battle

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things are different now compared to before her body was fully developed.
For Tamamo Cross, "hunger" is the ultimate source of strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bigger the stakes, the more the body demands
"thirst" in order to win. In a sense,
this was an inevitable transformation.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see, so she's in combat mode, huh...
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's just gonna keep pushin' full steam ahead...
Eatin', eatin', eatin', trainin',
and gettin' stronger and stronger...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, I can't do that. The harder
I try to train, the deeper into a rut I sink...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I can't see... any hope... Knowing Oguri
down to her very bones, I can tell..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I can't win like this...
She's definitely gonna surpass me..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Is there... is there any way?
Some way to surpass Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we try to face Oguri Cap's weapon of "abundance"
with "abundance" of our own, we likely won't win. Which means—
choice_data_list: We have no choice but to hone our "hunger."
I guess we just have to hone our "hunger."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Hunger"... Aye, you're right.
My greatest strength is my hunger.
That's one thing I won't lose to Oguri on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I have no choice but to be stoic to the core.
To hone myself even further, right to the limit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She falls deep into thought for a long while.
A silence lingers between us, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Is it actually possible
that I'm too blessed right now...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When things go halfway well, people play it safe.
If that's the case—just get rid of whatever they're protectin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is it. There's no other choice.
In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross's eyes took on a resolute, steely glint, as if she had made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm the "White Lightning".
And lightning, by its very nature, is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It just flashes for a second and disappears, right?
Then—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ain't it weirder to think we can keep runnin'
healthy for years and years like Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thinking you can win with that kind of mindset—
is where you've got it wrong.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "There's no need to run forever. If you think about the future, your edge dulls; if you don't think—its sharpness only keenens."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It'll be over in a flash. There are only one or two battles left with Oguri.
And there—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What if I put my resolve, my entire racing career,
everything on the line? What do you say to that?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: If I do that, I'm sure I can become it. The strongest and fastest "White Lightning" that surpasses even Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...There was nothin' there from the start. If I get greedy
and end up missin' out on the thing I want most,
I'd be a laughin'stock.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What if I throw everything else away and stake my whole life on this winter?!
If I do that, then maybe, just maybe—
choice_data_list: I'm prepared to retire from the Twinkle Series if it comes to that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Dad said so too: "Once you've seen it through to the end,
you're free to quit."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Knowin' when to call it quits is important. This year's
Arima is my last race. I'll do what needs to be done,
and then spend time with my family...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How about this, then? This'll be our last time together...
Even so... won't ya aim for victory with me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wanna make 'em say it.
"Tamamo Cross was stronger than Oguri Cap."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"And I wanna be able to think, 'My racing career
was the absolute best precisely because it was never complete!'
...y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
This is the "top" I'm aimin' for.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather die than have any regrets! Please!!
Let me seize the very top...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...There was no way... I could ever oppose it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross is putting her entire reason for being on the line. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch, Trainer! In that case,
I'm gonna push myself all the way toward that goal!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't need anything except victory. Nothing—
Even if I grind everything to dust, I'll win.
Even if it kills me—no, even if I die—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From that day on, intense special training began.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...! Not enough, still not enough...!
More power... I'm starving for it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I want it... I want it... No matter what,
the power to overcome... the power to break through...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... How many... days left?
Until the next race... just how many...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gimme time! Even just a second—!
I'll pour all my blood into whatever opening I get!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross is giving it her all, and so am I managing her. We push hard right up to the limit without breaking her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of the White Lightning grew painfully bright.
Carrying the very life of Tamamo Cross with it.
